reader_summary.overview: In this episode of Far From The Finishing Post we speak to Nick Martin. Nick manages Polar Capital's Global Insurance strategy and has been investing in the insurance industry for 20 years. Nick does a great job of demystifying a complex industry and explaining why the best property & casualty insurers are strong and durable compounding machines.

key_points.text: Nick manages Polar Capital's Global Insurance strategy and has been investing in the insurance industry for 20 years.
Nick does a great job of demystifying a complex industry and explaining why the best property & casualty insurers are strong and durable compounding machines.

notes: In this episode of Far From The Finishing Post we speak to Nick Martin. Nick manages Polar Capital's Global Insurance strategy and has been investing in the insurance industry for 20 years.
